items.title: Schuller Gunther — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Many times, of course, Charlie Parker wasn’t around, or he was in a hospital in California. He had a terrible drug problem. But I did get to meet him many times.

ctx.x: I’ll have to pull that LP out. I have it. I have it on my shelf. Charlie Parker. Did you ever have any personal dealings with him?

Like I said much earlier, I got to know almost instantaneously every great jazz musician and of course Charlie Parker, always through John Lewis. They were very close. Many times, of course, Charlie Parker wasn’t around, or he was in a hospital in California. He had a terrible drug problem. But I did get to meet him many times. The last time was – and of course I went to hear him many times, and all of that, when he played at Birdland and so on. But the last time I saw him was at a big party that the – here I go…
